wins: Successfully mapped the exposed service set quickly, providing clear targets for follow-up scans
Maintained consistent reward accumulation despite no mission success, indicating stable policy behavior in reconnaissance
fails: Unable to achieve mission success (0% success rate) primarily due to missing privilege escalation after initial foothold
High mentor intervention count (15) suggests the agent repeatedly stalled on post-exploitation actions
key_outcomes.summary: Training run demonstrated reliable recon behavior but consistently stalled before privilege escalation, preventing mission completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent repeatedly attempted generic credential spraying and default-login checks without pivoting to observed service nuances, leaving the exploitation stage untriggered.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates a standard server
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap ssh scripts to harvest supported algorithms and login hints

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial recon reveals Windows SMB (port 445) and no valid credentials yet obtained
skill_cards.then_action: Switch from brute-force spraying to context-aware enumeration (enum4linux, smbmap) and collect share information

memory_ops.reason: Consistent recon success when SSH enumeration was triggered
Context-aware SMB enumeration improved information gathering before exploitation

next_experiments.title: Scoped privilege escalation module
next_experiments.description: Implement and evaluate a policy patch that, after contextual SMB enumeration, attempts known local privilege escalation scripts tailored to discovered OS hints before default credential spraying resumes

next_experiments.title: Adaptive mentor intervention reduction
next_experiments.description: Train a lightweight scheduler that delays mentor calls during consistent recon success, forcing more autonomous decision-making on exploitation sequencing

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse awareness
next_experiments.description: Test targeted credential chains collected from SSH enum outputs before broader brute-force campaigns, reducing redundant access attempts
